title: Higher order KdV-type equations with Robin boundary conditions on $\mathbb{R}^+$
summary: We study the initial boundary value problem (IBVP) for the higher order Korteweg--de Vries type equation \[\partial_tu+(-1)^{j+1}\partial_x^{2j+1}u+\frac12\partial_x(u^2)=0,\qquad j\in\mathbb{N},\] on the right half line, subject to the Robin boundary conditions \[(\partial_x+γ)\partial_x^{\ell-1}u(t,0)=\varphi_\ell(t),\qquad 1\le\ell\le j,\] where $γ\in\mathbb{R}$ is common to all boundary conditions.
